implemented_requirements.requirement: Player controls a snake using directional inputs

implemented_requirements.evidence: Method step() updates the snake head position based on current direction and inserts it into self.snake, then draw() renders the board each tick.

When head == self.food, score is increased and new food is spawned:
```python
if head == self.food:
    self.score += 1
    self.grow += 1
    self.food = self.spawn_food()
```

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each time the snake eats, it grows in length
implemented_requirements.evidence: self.grow is incremented on eating; step() delays popping the tail while self.grow > 0, effectively growing the snake.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if the snake collides with itself or the boundary
implemented_requirements.evidence:
Collision detection in step():
```python
if x < 0 or x >= COLS or y < 0 or y >= ROWS or head in body:
    self.game_over()
```
tick() calls step() then draw() and schedules the next tick with root.after.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Show the current score based on food eaten

```python
c.create_text(10, BAR // 2, anchor="w", fill=WHITE,

```
